rows: Issues standard certificates. Special wording goes to the account manager.
Sends questionnaires, chases answers and flags what changed since last year.
Collects the details and fills in the rater. A licensed agent presents the quote.
ID cards and proof of insurance
Sends them to clients, lenders and landlords on request.
Prepares the change. A licensed person submits it.
Gives the carrier claims number, logs the details, briefs the team.

images.name: monday
images.title: A Monday at an *insurance agency*
rows: Reports two weekend claims to the carriers and leaves the claim numbers on each file.
Issues a standard certificate to a contractor's property owner before the crew starts.
The same contractor asks for additional insured wording. It sends the contract to the account manager.
Sends renewal questionnaires to 11 commercial clients renewing in 90 days.
A client bought a car Saturday. It prepares the change for a licensed person to submit.
Spots a pending cancellation notice for nonpayment and texts the client the same hour.
A client asks whether a burst pipe is covered. It pulls the policy and books a call.

steps: Read agency agreements and portal terms for rules on automated access and data.
Tag last month's requests: certificates, renewals, changes, billing, claims.
Which holders get a standard certificate and which need a person.
Management system, rater, email and phone. No binding, no cancelling.
Coverage questions, changes, disputes and upset clients go to a named person.

Update it when carriers change forms, appetite or portals.
